summary: YouTube says product tags got over 2x more clicks than description links in a July 2026 experiment, a clear push to keep shopping inside YouTube's own tools.
Meesho coverage keeps growing: India's marketplace is opening 30 million products to YouTube Shopping creators. More Australia launch coverage also landed.
Button's CEO argued at an ADWEEK/Pinterest event that creators are a commerce channel, not just talent. LTK shared a creator case study claiming 478% year-on-year GMV growth.
Lasso and URLgenius were quiet, and Amazon's own news was not about its affiliate tools.

items.title: ADWEEK x Pinterest 'Creator Commerce Equation' talk: CEO Michael Jaconi says creators are a commerce channel, not just talent
YouTube: product tags got 2x+ more product clicks than description links (July 2026 experiment)
items.why: YouTube is steering creators away from description links toward its own tags. Off-platform links may get less space, so the data behind which link wins matters more.
